005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.command3.Scheduler.ScheduleResult;
010import org.wpilib.system.RobotController;
011
012/**
013 * An event that occurs during scheduler processing. This can range from {@link Scheduled a command
014 * being scheduled} by a trigger or manual call to {@link Scheduler#schedule(Command)} to {@link
015 * Interrupted a command being interrupted by another}. Event listeners can be registered with a
016 * scheduler via {@link Scheduler#addEventListener(Consumer)}. All events have a timestamp to
017 * indicate when the event occurred.
018 *
019 * <p>This class is provided by the Commands v3 VendorDep
020 */
021public sealed interface SchedulerEvent {
022  /**
023   * The timestamp for when the event occurred. Measured in nanoseconds since some arbitrary start
024   * time.
025   *
026   * @return The event timestamp.
027   * @see RobotController#getTime()
028   */
029  long timestampNanos();
030
031  /**
032   * An event marking when a command is scheduled in {@link Scheduler#schedule(Command)}.
033   *
034   * @param command The command that was scheduled
035   * @param timestampNanos When the command was scheduled
036   */
037  record Scheduled(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
038
039  /**
040   * An event marking when a command starts running.
041   *
042   * @param command The command that started
043   * @param timestampNanos When the command started
044   */
045  record Mounted(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
046
047  /**
048   * An event marking when a command yielded control with {@link Coroutine#yield()}.
049   *
050   * @param command The command that yielded
051   * @param timestampNanos When the command yielded
052   */
053  record Yielded(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
054
055  /**
056   * An event marking when a command completed naturally.
057   *
058   * @param command The command that completed
059   * @param timestampNanos When the command completed
060   */
061  record Completed(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
062
063  /**
064   * An event marking when a command threw or encountered an unhanded exception.
065   *
066   * @param command The command that encountered the error
067   * @param error The unhandled error
068   * @param timestampNanos When the error occurred
069   */
070  record CompletedWithError(Command command, Throwable error, long timestampNanos)
071      implements SchedulerEvent {}
072
073  /**
074   * An event marking when a command was canceled. If the command was canceled because it was
075   * interrupted by another command, an {@link Interrupted} will be emitted immediately prior to the
076   * cancellation event.
077   *
078   * @param command The command that was canceled
079   * @param timestampNanos When the command was canceled
080   */
081  record Canceled(Command command, long timestampNanos) implements SchedulerEvent {}
082
083  /**
084   * An event marking when a command was interrupted by another. Typically followed by an {@link
085   * Canceled} event.
086   *
087   * @param command The command that was interrupted
088   * @param interrupter The interrupting command
089   * @param timestampNanos When the command was interrupted
090   */
091  record Interrupted(Command command, Command interrupter, long timestampNanos)
092      implements SchedulerEvent {}
093
094  /**
095   * An event marking when a child command could not be forked.
096   *
097   * @param command The command attempting to fork the child commands
098   * @param failures The reasons the child commands could not be forked
099   * @param timestampNanos When the child commands were attempted to be forked
100   */
101  record ForkFailure(Command command, List<ScheduleResult.Failure> failures, long timestampNanos)
102      implements SchedulerEvent {}
103}
